title: Fast Regularized Policy Mirror Descent with One-Step TD Updates
abstract: arXiv:2609.39837v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Policy mirror descent (PMD) enjoys fast convergence in regularized Markov decision processes (MDPs), but existing guarantees often rely on exact or increasingly accurate policy evaluation. We analyze PMD coupled with a persistent critic advanced by one temporal-difference (TD) update. For finite discounted MDPs, we establish global linear convergence in value for exact coordinate-wise Bellman updates, with any positive constant actor stepsize and arbitrary finite critic initialization. The proof combines a resolvent-based auxiliary distribution with a decaying Bellman-violation correction and a potential weighted by inverse coordinate weights. We then study stochastic TD-PMD with general strongly convex mirror maps under a single off-policy Markov trajectory. translated_title: 基于单步时序差分更新的快速正则化策略镜像下降
translated_abstract: 策略镜像下降（PMD）在正则化马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中具有快速收敛的特性，但现有的理论保证通常依赖于精确的或日益精确的策略评估。我们分析了将策略镜像下降与一个通过单步时序差分（TD）更新推进的持久评论家相结合的方法。对于有限折扣MDP，我们在精确逐坐标贝尔曼更新的情形下，证明了值函数的全局线性收敛性，且该结论对任意正常数行动者步长和任意有限初始化的评论家均成立。证明结合了基于预解式的辅助分布、衰减的贝尔曼违反校正项，以及按坐标权重倒数加权的势函数。随后，我们研究了在单一离策略马尔可夫轨迹下、具有一般强凸镜像映射的随机时序差分策略镜像下降（TD-PMD）。通过选取合适的常数步长和有限批量的TD更新，该方法在 $\widetilde{O}(1/((1-\gamma)^5 \widetilde{\sigma}$……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次证明策略镜像下降只需搭配每步仅执行一次TD更新的持久评论家，即可在任意常数行动者步长和任意评论家初始化下实现值函数的全局线性收敛，并进一步给出了离策略轨迹下随机TD-PMD的收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes global linear convergence of policy mirror descent coupled with a persistent critic advanced by only a single TD update, valid for any positive constant actor stepsize and arbitrary critic initialization, and further extends the analysis to stochastic TD-PMD under off-policy trajectories with strongly convex mirror maps.
